blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Motorists who check messages, answer calls, or browse their phones while waiting at a red light risk apprehension under the Anti-Distracted Driving Act, which prohibits handheld cellphone use even when vehicles temporarily stop at intersections.
